$comment: One-tap reports for MDS_EPD. Loaded with TEMPLATES_FILE. SQL is verified on SQL Server (sql) and on the converted .mdf in DuckDB (sqlDuckdb when the syntax differs). Placeholders: {{date}}, {{date+1}}, {{today-30}}, {{today-days}}, {{limit}}; see apps/server/src/reports/template.ts.

templates.title: Today's sales
templates.description: Invoices, net sales and customers for one day.
templates.descriptionUr: ایک دن کی انوائسز، نیٹ سیل اور گاہک۔
templates.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices, COALESCE(SUM(net_amt), 0) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS customers FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= {{day}} AND inv_date < {{day+1}}

templates.title: Sales at a glance
templates.description: Invoices, net sales and customers for a period (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: کسی مدت کی انوائسز، نیٹ سیل اور گاہک (پہلے سے اس مہینے کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices, COALESCE(SUM(net_amt), 0) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS customers FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= {{from}} AND inv_date < {{to+1}}

templates.title: Daily sales
templates.description: Net sales day by day (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: دن بہ دن نیٹ سیل (پہلے سے اس مہینے کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT CAST(inv_date AS DATE) AS day, SUM(net_amt) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= {{from}} AND inv_date < {{to+1}} GROUP BY CAST(inv_date AS DATE) ORDER BY day

templates.title: Monthly sales
templates.description: Net sales month by month with growth (this year by default).
templates.descriptionUr: مہینہ وار نیٹ سیل اور اضافہ (پہلے سے اس سال کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT YEAR(inv_date) AS year, MONTH(inv_date) AS month, SUM(net_amt) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM dbo.InvoiceLine WHERE inv_date >= {{from}} AND inv_date < {{today+1}} GROUP BY YEAR(inv_date), MONTH(inv_date) ORDER BY year, month

templates.title: Top customers
templates.description: Customers ranked by net sales (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: نیٹ سیل کے لحاظ سے بڑے گاہک (پہلے سے اس مہینے کے)۔
templates.sql: SELECT TOP ({{limit}}) c.cust_name AS customer, SUM(i.net_amt) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM dbo.InvoiceLine AS i JOIN dbo.Customer AS c ON c.cust_id = i.cust_id WHERE i.inv_date >= {{from}} AND i.inv_date < {{to+1}} GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT c.cust_name AS customer, SUM(i.net_amt) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM dbo.InvoiceLine AS i JOIN dbo.Customer AS c ON c.cust_id = i.cust_id WHERE i.inv_date >= {{from}} AND i.inv_date < {{to+1}} GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

templates.title: Best-selling products
templates.titleUr: سب سے زیادہ بکنے والی مصنوعات
templates.description: Products ranked by units sold (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: بکنے والی اکائیوں کے لحاظ سے مصنوعات (پہلے سے اس مہینے کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT TOP ({{limit}}) p.name AS product, co.comp_name AS company, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS units, SUM(d.total_net) AS net_sales FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail AS d JOIN dbo.InvoiceLine AS i ON i.inv_no = d.inv_no JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.comp_id = d.comp_id AND p.group_id = d.group_id AND p.prod_id = d.prod_id JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = d.comp_id WHERE i.inv_date >= {{from}} AND i.inv_date < {{to+1}} GROUP BY p.comp_id, p.group_id, p.prod_id, p.name, co.comp_name ORDER BY units DESC
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT p.name AS product, co.comp_name AS company, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS units, SUM(d.total_net) AS net_sales FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail AS d JOIN dbo.InvoiceLine AS i ON i.inv_no = d.inv_no JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.comp_id = d.comp_id AND p.group_id = d.group_id AND p.prod_id = d.prod_id JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = d.comp_id WHERE i.inv_date >= {{from}} AND i.inv_date < {{to+1}} GROUP BY p.comp_id, p.group_id, p.prod_id, p.name, co.comp_name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

templates.title: Sales by company
templates.description: Net sales per principal company (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: ہر کمپنی کی نیٹ سیل (پہلے سے اس مہینے کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT TOP ({{limit}}) co.comp_name AS company, SUM(d.total_net) AS net_sales, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS units FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail AS d JOIN dbo.InvoiceLine AS i ON i.inv_no = d.inv_no JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = d.comp_id WHERE i.inv_date >= {{from}} AND i.inv_date < {{to+1}} GROUP BY co.comp_id, co.comp_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT co.comp_name AS company, SUM(d.total_net) AS net_sales, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS units FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail AS d JOIN dbo.InvoiceLine AS i ON i.inv_no = d.inv_no JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = d.comp_id WHERE i.inv_date >= {{from}} AND i.inv_date < {{to+1}} GROUP BY co.comp_id, co.comp_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

templates.title: Sales by booking man
templates.description: Net sales and invoices per salesman (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: ہر بکنگ مین کی نیٹ سیل اور انوائسز (پہلے سے اس مہینے کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT b.bName AS booking_man, SUM(i.net_amt) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS invoices, COUNT(DISTINCT i.cust_id) AS customers FROM dbo.InvoiceLine AS i JOIN dbo.BookingMan AS b ON b.bId = i.bId WHERE i.inv_date >= {{from}} AND i.inv_date < {{to+1}} GROUP BY b.bId, b.bName ORDER BY net_sales DESC

templates.title: Stock shortage
templates.description: Products that are selling but will run out within the given days at the last 30 days' sales rate. Out-of-stock items first.
templates.descriptionUr: بکنے والی مصنوعات جن کا اسٹاک پچھلے 30 دن کی رفتار سے دیے گئے دنوں میں ختم ہو جائے گا۔ ختم شدہ پہلے۔
templates.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT d.comp_id, d.group_id, d.prod_id, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS qty FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail AS d JOIN dbo.InvoiceLine AS i ON i.inv_no = d.inv_no WHERE i.inv_date >= {{today-30}} AND i.inv_date < {{today+1}} GROUP BY d.comp_id, d.group_id, d.prod_id) SELECT TOP (500) p.name AS product, co.comp_name AS company, p.stock AS in_stock, s.qty AS sold_30_days, CAST(CASE WHEN p.stock <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.stock * 30.0 / s.qty END AS DECIMAL(10, 1)) AS days_left FROM sold AS s JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.comp_id = s.comp_id AND p.group_id = s.group_id AND p.prod_id = s.prod_id JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = p.comp_id WHERE s.qty > 0 AND ISNULL(p.del, 0) = 0 AND p.stock * 30.0 / s.qty < {{days}} ORDER BY days_left, sold_30_days DESC, product, p.comp_id, p.group_id, p.prod_id
templates.sqlDuckdb: WITH sold AS (SELECT d.comp_id, d.group_id, d.prod_id, SUM(d.sale_qty) AS qty FROM dbo.InvoiceDetail AS d JOIN dbo.InvoiceLine AS i ON i.inv_no = d.inv_no WHERE i.inv_date >= {{today-30}} AND i.inv_date < {{today+1}} GROUP BY d.comp_id, d.group_id, d.prod_id) SELECT p.name AS product, co.comp_name AS company, p.stock AS in_stock, s.qty AS sold_30_days, CAST(CASE WHEN p.stock <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.stock * 30.0 / s.qty END AS DECIMAL(10, 1)) AS days_left FROM sold AS s JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.comp_id = s.comp_id AND p.group_id = s.group_id AND p.prod_id = s.prod_id JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = p.comp_id WHERE s.qty > 0 AND NOT COALESCE(p.del, false) AND p.stock * 30.0 / s.qty < {{days}} ORDER BY days_left, sold_30_days DESC, product, p.comp_id, p.group_id, p.prod_id LIMIT 500

templates.title: Stock expiring soon
templates.description: Batches in stock that expire before the given date (90 days by default), soonest first.
templates.descriptionUr: اسٹاک کے وہ بیچ جن کی میعاد دی گئی تاریخ سے پہلے ختم ہو رہی ہے۔
templates.sql: SELECT TOP (200) p.name AS product, co.comp_name AS company, s.batchNo AS batch, s.qty AS units, CAST(s.expdate AS DATE) AS expires, DATEDIFF(day, {{today}}, s.expdate) AS days_left, CAST(s.qty * s.purchaseprice AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS stock_value FROM dbo.StockDetail AS s JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.comp_id = s.comp_id AND p.group_id = s.group_id AND p.prod_id = s.prod_id JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = s.comp_id WHERE s.qty > 0 AND s.expdate >= {{today}} AND s.expdate < {{until+1}} ORDER BY s.expdate, p.name
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT p.name AS product, co.comp_name AS company, s.batchNo AS batch, s.qty AS units, CAST(s.expdate AS DATE) AS expires, date_diff('day', {{today}}, CAST(s.expdate AS DATE)) AS days_left, CAST(s.qty * s.purchaseprice AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS stock_value FROM dbo.StockDetail AS s JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.comp_id = s.comp_id AND p.group_id = s.group_id AND p.prod_id = s.prod_id JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = s.comp_id WHERE s.qty > 0 AND s.expdate >= {{today}} AND s.expdate < {{until+1}} ORDER BY s.expdate, p.name LIMIT 200

templates.title: Expired stock on hand
templates.description: Batches still in stock past their expiry date, largest value first.
templates.descriptionUr: وہ بیچ جو میعاد ختم ہونے کے بعد بھی اسٹاک میں ہیں۔
templates.sql: SELECT TOP (200) p.name AS product, co.comp_name AS company, s.batchNo AS batch, s.qty AS units, CAST(s.expdate AS DATE) AS expired_on, CAST(s.qty * s.purchaseprice AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS stock_value FROM dbo.StockDetail AS s JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.comp_id = s.comp_id AND p.group_id = s.group_id AND p.prod_id = s.prod_id JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = s.comp_id WHERE s.qty > 0 AND s.expdate < {{today}} ORDER BY stock_value DESC, p.name
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT p.name AS product, co.comp_name AS company, s.batchNo AS batch, s.qty AS units, CAST(s.expdate AS DATE) AS expired_on, CAST(s.qty * s.purchaseprice AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS stock_value FROM dbo.StockDetail AS s JOIN dbo.Product AS p ON p.comp_id = s.comp_id AND p.group_id = s.group_id AND p.prod_id = s.prod_id JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = s.comp_id WHERE s.qty > 0 AND s.expdate < {{today}} ORDER BY stock_value DESC, p.name LIMIT 200

templates.title: Customers who owe the most
templates.titleUr: سب سے زیادہ بقایا والے گاہک
templates.description: Outstanding receivable balance per customer, largest first.
templates.descriptionUr: ہر گاہک کا بقایا، سب سے زیادہ پہلے۔
templates.sql: SELECT TOP ({{limit}}) c.cust_name AS customer, a.name AS area, c.cust_rec_balance AS balance, c.credit_limit FROM dbo.Customer AS c LEFT JOIN dbo.TblArea AS a ON a.area_id = c.area_id WHERE c.cust_rec_balance > 0 AND ISNULL(c.del, 0) = 0 ORDER BY balance DESC
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT c.cust_name AS customer, a.name AS area, c.cust_rec_balance AS balance, c.credit_limit FROM dbo.Customer AS c LEFT JOIN dbo.TblArea AS a ON a.area_id = c.area_id WHERE c.cust_rec_balance > 0 AND NOT COALESCE(c.del, false) ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

templates.title: Over credit limit
templates.description: Customers whose balance is above their credit limit.
templates.descriptionUr: وہ گاہک جن کا بقایا ان کی کریڈٹ حد سے زیادہ ہے۔
templates.sql: SELECT c.cust_name AS customer, a.name AS area, c.cust_rec_balance AS balance, c.credit_limit, c.cust_rec_balance - c.credit_limit AS over_by FROM dbo.Customer AS c LEFT JOIN dbo.TblArea AS a ON a.area_id = c.area_id WHERE c.credit_limit > 0 AND c.cust_rec_balance > c.credit_limit AND ISNULL(c.del, 0) = 0 ORDER BY over_by DESC
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT c.cust_name AS customer, a.name AS area, c.cust_rec_balance AS balance, c.credit_limit, c.cust_rec_balance - c.credit_limit AS over_by FROM dbo.Customer AS c LEFT JOIN dbo.TblArea AS a ON a.area_id = c.area_id WHERE c.credit_limit > 0 AND c.cust_rec_balance > c.credit_limit AND NOT COALESCE(c.del, false) ORDER BY over_by DESC

templates.title: Cash received
templates.description: Cash collected from customers day by day (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: گاہکوں سے روزانہ وصول ہونے والی رقم (پہلے سے اس مہینے کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT CAST([date] AS DATE) AS day, SUM(amt) AS received, COUNT(*) AS receipts FROM dbo.CashRecieved WHERE [date] >= {{from}} AND [date] < {{to+1}} GROUP BY CAST([date] AS DATE) ORDER BY day
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT CAST("date" AS DATE) AS day, SUM(amt) AS received, COUNT(*) AS receipts FROM dbo.CashRecieved WHERE "date" >= {{from}} AND "date" < {{to+1}} GROUP BY CAST("date" AS DATE) ORDER BY day

templates.title: Sales returns by customer
templates.description: Returned value per customer (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: ہر گاہک کی واپس کی گئی مالیت (پہلے سے اس مہینے کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT TOP ({{limit}}) c.cust_name AS customer, SUM(r.netamount) AS returned, COUNT(*) AS returns FROM dbo.SalesReturnLine AS r JOIN dbo.Customer AS c ON c.cust_id = r.cust_id WHERE r.srdate >= {{from}} AND r.srdate < {{to+1}} GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_name ORDER BY returned DESC
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT c.cust_name AS customer, SUM(r.netamount) AS returned, COUNT(*) AS returns FROM dbo.SalesReturnLine AS r JOIN dbo.Customer AS c ON c.cust_id = r.cust_id WHERE r.srdate >= {{from}} AND r.srdate < {{to+1}} GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_name ORDER BY returned DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

templates.title: Customers who stopped buying
templates.description: Customers who bought in the last 180 days but not in the last N days, biggest buyers first.
templates.descriptionUr: وہ گاہک جنہوں نے پچھلے 180 دن میں خریدا مگر حالیہ دنوں میں نہیں۔
templates.sql: SELECT TOP (50) c.cust_name AS customer, a.name AS area, CAST(MAX(i.inv_date) AS DATE) AS last_invoice, DATEDIFF(day, MAX(i.inv_date), {{today}}) AS days_since, SUM(i.net_amt) AS sales_180_days FROM dbo.InvoiceLine AS i JOIN dbo.Customer AS c ON c.cust_id = i.cust_id LEFT JOIN dbo.TblArea AS a ON a.area_id = c.area_id WHERE i.inv_date >= {{today-180}} GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_name, a.name HAVING MAX(i.inv_date) < {{today-days}} ORDER BY sales_180_days DESC
templates.sqlDuckdb: SELECT c.cust_name AS customer, a.name AS area, CAST(MAX(i.inv_date) AS DATE) AS last_invoice, date_diff('day', CAST(MAX(i.inv_date) AS DATE), {{today}}) AS days_since, SUM(i.net_amt) AS sales_180_days FROM dbo.InvoiceLine AS i JOIN dbo.Customer AS c ON c.cust_id = i.cust_id LEFT JOIN dbo.TblArea AS a ON a.area_id = c.area_id WHERE i.inv_date >= {{today-180}} GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_name, a.name HAVING MAX(i.inv_date) < {{today-days}} ORDER BY sales_180_days DESC LIMIT 50

templates.title: Purchases by company
templates.description: Purchase invoices from each principal (this month by default).
templates.descriptionUr: ہر کمپنی سے خریداری (پہلے سے اس مہینے کی)۔
templates.sql: SELECT co.comp_name AS company, SUM(pl.netamount) AS purchased, COUNT(*) AS invoices FROM dbo.PurchaseLine AS pl JOIN dbo.Company AS co ON co.comp_id = pl.comp_id WHERE pl.pdate >= {{from}} AND pl.pdate < {{to+1}} GROUP BY co.comp_id, co.comp_name ORDER BY purchased DESC
